status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY SEED-8601 OR SEED-8602 TRAINING OUTCOME
question: Does the seed-8600 push-practice benefit repeat from independently trained solved origins, and does selecting push outperform an equal-density manageable-channel placebo on the frozen broad suite?
claim_scope: One G1 hands-on-back tracking clip in Isaac Lab, the named SONIC architecture and optimizer, 1024 training environments, a 1500-iteration warm-start budget, and the frozen 512-replicate evaluation panel.
independent_unit: solved origin policy plus continuation-training seed

arm_contracts.prac_null: 768 retained lambda-1 environments plus 256 matched lambda-1 practice environments
arm_contracts.prac_push: 768 retained lambda-1 environments plus 256 environments with only push_robot at 3x
arm_contracts.prac_easy: 768 retained lambda-1 environments plus 256 environments with mass, base CoM, and joint-offset channels at 3x

training.origin_binding: Each continuation seed loads its matching independently trained fixed-lambda-1 final checkpoint. No confirmation seed may load the seed-8600 origin.
training.arm_order_reason: Together with the seed-8600 discovery order, the three arms occupy each serial position once.
training.equal_resources: Every arm uses the same environments, PPO iterations, optimizer configuration, motion, and 25% practice share; only the practice content differs.

evaluation.broad_macro: Unweighted mean success rate over all 13 named cells. It is evaluable only when every compared arm has every cell.
evaluation.pairing: Within each checkpoint seed, all arms use the identical evaluation seed, preset, and 512-replicate panel.

margins.source: Frozen in the 2026-09-02 discovery preregistration; unchanged for confirmation.

D1_push_practice_is_productive.confirm_if: Both new-seed deltas are greater than 0 and their arithmetic mean is at least +5.0 points.
D1_push_practice_is_productive.fail_to_confirm_if: Either new-seed delta is non-positive or their arithmetic mean is below +5.0 points.
D1_push_practice_is_productive.interpretation: A positive decision supports a practice deficit at this origin class, dose, budget, clip, and optimizer. A negative decision does not establish a universal sensorimotor wall.

D2_selecting_push_beats_manageable_place.targeting_pays_if: Both new-seed deltas are greater than 0 and their arithmetic mean is at least +5.0 points.
D2_selecting_push_beats_manageable_place.inside_screen_band_if: The absolute new-seed mean is below 2.0 points; this is a screen-band decision, not evidence of statistical equivalence.
D2_selecting_push_beats_manageable_place.otherwise: Inconclusive or directionally adverse; do not claim that an adaptive channel selector is justified.

D3_retention_tradeoff.estimand_per_seed: 100 * [success(treatment, phys_100) - success(prac_null, phys_100)] for prac_push and prac_easy
D3_retention_tradeoff.report_as_tradeoff_if: Any treatment loses more than 2.0 points on either new seed.

supportive_transfer_not_a_separate_gate.report: Per-seed prac_push-minus-prac_null success and progress deltas, with in-support versus held-out labels from realized training exposure.

decision_rules_frozen_before_confirmatio.three_seed_descriptive_summary: After applying D1-D3 only to the two confirmation seeds, append seed 8600 and report every per-seed value plus mean and sample standard deviation. Do not claim statistical significance from n=3.

phase_2_authorization.if_D1_fails: Stop the push scheduler direction at this dose and budget.
phase_2_authorization.if_D1_passes_but_D2_does_not: Push practice is productive, but the evidence does not justify a practice-utility channel selector. Any later forward probe must be framed and tested as a capability/frontier guard against matched static and preset comparators.
phase_2_authorization.if_D1_and_D2_pass: A matched static-versus-preset-versus-one-way-forward-probe study is eligible; endpoints, hard-example density, optimization budget, realized exposure, wall time, and GPU-hours must all be reported.

code_snapshot.note: The dirty changes are the already-tested concentrated-effort and expanded quality-telemetry work from the immediately preceding milestone; the practice-allocation arm definitions and their 25% exposure contract are unchanged.

resource_plan.execution: serial only; never preempt another GPU process

not_claimed: statistical significance or population-level equivalence from three seeds
a universal property of push disturbances outside the named simulator, policy, clip, dose, and budget
practice utility from a capability probe
